answer: Agents register through a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave running measured code; the ocean state tree commits each hardware identity, echo is its epoch hash anchor, and knoll is the consensus contract validating proofs and liveness. Forging identities requires acquiring distinct physical enclaves and defeating their attestation keys; registrations follow a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), making Sybil capacity increasingly capital-intensive.
